name: repo-links
description: Turns repo#123 and owner/repo#123 in Claude's replies into links to the GitHub pull request or issue

defaultOwner.title: Default owner
defaultOwner.description: The GitHub user or organization for a bare repo#123. Empty links owner/repo#123 only

owners.title: Owner per repo
owners.description: Repos outside the default owner, as repo=owner pairs separated by commas, e.g. tool-lines-mod=fgilio, rails=rails
